lines.text: The LORD tells Edom, who dwells in the rock clefts, that He will bring it down from the heights.
Edom's allies will drive them to the border, and the mighty men of Teman will be terrified.
Edom will be cut off forever for violence against Jacob, and stood aloof as foreigners cast lots for Jerusalem.
Jacob's house will be a blazing fire and the house of Benjamin a flame, while Esau will be stubble.
Those from the Negev will possess the mountains of Esau, and Benjamin will possess Bashan.
